# Graph routing regression corpus

This project freezes the fifteen source graphs that established routing score ceilings. Their original source preserves graph identities and complexity; simplifying the graphs would invalidate those ceilings. The remaining assets provide only call, event and typed spawn signatures. No playable scene, terrain or game composition is included.

`fixtures.json` records each source and reason for inclusion. Tests own this corpus independently of Voidweaver. Run the routing checks for affected graph contracts and report their results.
